items.title: Audit finds Inpex has taken steps to improve its emissions reporting

items.title: Influential NT cultural and religious leader dies aged 91

children.content: An influential cultural and religious leader from south-east Arnhem Land has died aged 91 after being ordained as the Anglican church's first-ever female, Aboriginal priest in 2009.

items.title: Women in Darwin forced to travel hundreds of kilometres for pregnancy scans

children.content: After losing a baby early in pregnancy, Sarah Williams was anxious to get a nuchal scan to check her baby was OK. But she found herself among a number of women in Darwin struggling to book an appointment.

image.altText: A close up photo of a woman and her baby.

items.title: Hundreds face homelessness within weeks amid government funding stand-off

children.content: More than 230 residents, including children, are facing eviction from Darwin's largest homeless shelter within weeks as the federal and Northern Territory governments remain locked in a funding stand-off.

image.altText: A woman and her baby looking sad.

items.title: Border Force seizes 1.7m cigarettes, thousands of vapes in WA, NT raids

children.content: The Australian Border Force has seized more than 1.7 million illegal cigarettes and thousands of vapes with a street value of more than $800,000 in a joint operation across Western Australian and the Northern Territory.

items.title: 'Darwin is a small place': NT deputy chief defends data centre disclosure
